articles.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
articles.excerpt: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
articles.summary: 面向 AI 编码 agent 的安全审计技能，把审计拆成多个阶段执行，输出可独立验证、机器可读的检查结果，降低 LLM 误报。适合在代码库或 CI 流程中做可复现的安全排查，也可为 Agent 补齐安全审查能力。

articles.title: anthropics/claude-code
articles.excerpt: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
articles.summary: 常驻终端的 agentic 编码工具，能理解整个代码库，执行例行任务、解释复杂代码并处理 git 工作流。开发者可直接在命令行里让 Claude 读写文件、跑测试、提交代码，适合日常开发、重构与自动化脚本场景。

articles.title: alibaba/open-code-review
articles.excerpt: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
articles.summary: 阿里开源的代码审查工具，采用确定性流水线加 LLM Agent 的混合架构，能给出精确到行的评论，内置多语言规则集（如空指针 NPE 等），并经过阿里规模实战验证。适合团队接入 CI 做自动化评审。

articles.title: affaan-m/ECC
articles.excerpt: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
articles.summary: 面向 AI 编码 agent 的 harness 性能优化系统，通过 skills、instincts、记忆、安全与研究优先的开发流程提升执行效果，兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等。适合同时使用多个 agent、希望统一调优的开发者。

articles.title: Tencent/BrowserSkill
articles.excerpt: Let AI agents use your real, logged-in browser without interrupting your work. CLI + extension for browser automation across any shell-capable AI agent.
articles.summary: 让 AI agent 直接调用你已登录的真实浏览器，同时不打断你自己的操作。通过 CLI 加浏览器扩展实现，任何能执行 shell 命令的 agent 都可接入，适合需要登录态的网页自动化、信息抓取与端到端测试场景。

articles.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
articles.excerpt: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
articles.summary: 由 Addy Osmani 整理的 AI 编码 agent 技能集，把生产级工程实践（代码质量、测试、评审等）封装成可复用的 skill，让 agent 在真实项目中按工程规范工作，适合为 Claude Code 等工具补齐工程能力。

articles.title: TencentCloud/Octop
articles.excerpt: A smarter, self-hosted AI assistant — multi-user, multi-agent.
articles.summary: 腾讯云开源的自托管 AI 助手，支持多用户与多 agent 协作，数据留在自有环境中。可用于团队内部搭建共享智能助理，接入知识库与内部工具链，适合对数据合规和私有部署有要求的企业场景。

articles.title: Fission-AI/OpenSpec
articles.excerpt: Spec-driven development (SDD) for AI coding assistants.
articles.summary: 为 AI 编码助手设计的规格驱动开发（SDD）框架：先把需求写成明确规格，再让 agent 按规格实现，减少自由发挥与返工。适合希望用规范约束 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具、提升交付可预测性的团队。

articles.title: ankitects/anki
articles.excerpt: Anki is a smart spaced repetition flashcard program
articles.summary: 老牌间隔重复记忆卡片软件，依据算法安排复习时间，用最少的重复次数记住语言单词、考试知识点等长期记忆内容。支持桌面端、移动端与同步，共享牌组生态庞大，适合学生和语言学习者。

articles.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
articles.excerpt: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
articles.summary: Anthropic 开源的知识工作者插件集合，主要面向 Claude Cowork 使用场景，把文档处理、信息整理等常见知识工作流封装成可安装插件。适合日常用 Claude 处理办公与内容工作的人按需扩展能力。

articles.title: supermemoryai/supermemory
articles.excerpt: Memory and context engine + app that is extremely fast, scalable, and can be run fully locally. The Memory API for the AI era.
articles.summary: 面向 AI 应用的记忆与上下文引擎，提供高速、可扩展的 Memory API，并支持完全本地运行。为 agent 和聊天应用持久化用户偏好与历史信息，解决上下文窗口有限、跨会话遗忘的问题。

articles.title: tradesdontlie/tradingview-mcp
articles.excerpt: AI-assisted TradingView chart analysis — connect Claude Code to your TradingView Desktop for personal workflow automation
articles.summary: 通过 MCP 把 Claude Code 连接到 TradingView 桌面端，让 AI 辅助分析行情图表，实现个人交易工作流自动化。适合做技术分析的个人交易者，把画线、指标计算与形态识别交给 AI 处理。

articles.title: rustfs/rustfs
articles.excerpt: RustFS is an open-source, S3-compatible high-performance object storage system supporting migration and coexistence with other S3-compatible platforms such as MinIO and Ceph.
articles.summary: 用 Rust 编写的开源高性能对象存储，兼容 S3 协议，支持与 MinIO、Ceph 等其他 S3 平台迁移和共存。可作为自建存储替代方案，适合私有云、AI 数据湖与备份等需要低成本高吞吐的场景。

articles.title: supabase/supabase
articles.excerpt: The Postgres development platform. Supabase gives you a dedicated Postgres database to build your web, mobile, and AI applications.
articles.summary: 基于 Postgres 的开发平台，为每个项目提供独立数据库，并配套认证、存储、实时订阅等能力，可快速搭建 Web、移动端和 AI 应用后端。开源且支持自托管，常被视为 Firebase 的替代方案。

articles.title: coder/coder

articles.summary: 把开发环境定义为代码，在自有云或本地集群中按需创建安全、可复现的远程开发机，供开发者和 AI agent 使用。适合需要统一环境、控制源码不出内网的团队，对 agent 执行任务也较友好。

articles.title: ahmedkhaleel2004/gitdiagram

articles.title: Introducing automatic remediation policies with Cloudflare CASB
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare CASB policies introduce a native automation engine built directly on the Cloudflare developer platform to remediate SaaS risks automatically. Security teams can now design event-driven logic to revoke risky file shares and send webhooks without manual intervention.

articles.title: How we rebuilt Cloudflare Workers’ module registry for Node.js compatibility
articles.excerpt: Workers now enables Node.js compatibility by default, supports applications up to 64 mebibytes, and adds a URL-based module registry with import.meta, lazy compilation, shared code caches, and clearer errors.

articles.title: Automatic Key Exchange: faster, post-quantum secure origin handshakes for 45 billion daily connections (and counting)
articles.excerpt: Automatic Key Exchange probes TLS 1.3-capable customer origins to learn which key agreement algorithms they support. We then lead with the most secure algorithm when connecting to the origin, preferring post-quantum connections wherever the origin supports it.

articles.title: Introducing context-aware vulnerability discovery and remediation with Cloudflare Managed Defense and OpenAI Daybreak models
articles.excerpt: Use production traffic and security signals to prioritize findings, prepare edge mitigations when safe, and propose code patches. articles.title: How we could save petabytes of cache storage with Zstandard and Pingora
articles.excerpt: Could we get more cache space with the same hardware? We prototyped compression inside Cloudflare's cache to find out.

articles.title: Introducing Adaptive Intelligence: Undermining the economics of every bot attack
articles.excerpt: Bot operators have historically had the economic advantage, bypassing static, deterministic detection rules with cheap proxies and retooling. Cloudflare's new Adaptive Intelligence engine flips this dynamic by autonomously learning from the meta-signals of live traffic and deploying disposable rules

articles.title: How we saved 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1’s DNS cache

articles.title: From all-or-nothing to task-based OAuth consent

articles.title: A revisit of remote Spectre attacks on Cloudflare Workers

articles.title: BGP Role model: tracking the adoption of RFC 9234

articles.title: How Cloudflare detects MCP traffic and helps secure it
